title: 第015章 百毒第016章 魔罗
lines: 第二艘宝船上。
一个熟悉的身影，挂在船首龙头位置，毒蛇帮的堂主——崔淼仁！
他的伤势极重。
身体被龙首的一双龙角贯穿琵琶骨，仿若妖魔的手臂从肩头探出，脑袋被某种蛮力削去了半边，肠子上挂着几只海鸥尸体。
“妖……鬼……”崔淼仁垂着脑袋，奄奄一息，反复呢喃着一句话。
众人不敢碰他。
这样的伤势能活着留一口气，已是奇迹。
若是将他放下，顷刻暴毙而亡。
金刀帮老帮主钱三金，上前小心查看。
“浑身骨骼如泥，血液似中了剧毒，连叼食的海鸥都毒死了。脑袋上的伤势，是被一股拳风余波擦过。”
最终得出结论。
“是先天极境的大高手！”
“他在极度恐慌中，不止一次激活了根骨的潜力，从煅骨……踏入了通脉。”毒蛇帮主谢天宇叹道。
众人闻言心头一股寒意。
崔淼仁居然是这样活下来的？这算是幸运，还是不幸？
就在这时。
又一声惊呼：“还有船，第三艘船回来了！”
众人纷纷转头。
周荣光神色大变，看向一旁气定神闲的陈孤舟。
脸上肌肉不禁一阵扭曲。
少顷。
第三艘宝船被拉进了码头。
依旧是陈孤舟打造的七十丈宝船，船楼被一股巨力踩入甲板，船舱内尽是人体组织爆开的血雾残渣。
别说活人，连一根完整的骨头都没有。
但宝船的下半部分却因坚硬的骨架，在惨烈的大战中保存了下来。
也因此。
众人在船舱最底部，发现了一个关键线索。
那是一种流水般的金属粉末，残留在木板缝隙中。船底破开一个大洞，似某个神秘的存在打穿了船底，将货物运走。
众人纷纷看向毒蛇帮帮主谢天宇、金刀帮帮主钱三金。
二人面色青黑，一言不发。
半晌。
钱三金道：“今日之事，还请诸位保守秘密。稍后……可至我金刀帮内，与诸位详谈。”
说罢。
他率人匆匆离去。
毒蛇帮主谢天宇则开始收拾残局，并向陈孤舟表示感谢。
“此番多亏陈匠师先见之明，否则我这些手足弟兄……怕是都不知道如何死的！”他咬了咬牙：“谢礼毒蛇帮稍后自会奉上，先告辞了。”
“谢帮主客气。”
陈孤舟微微颔首。
目送毒蛇、金刀帮的人带着三艘宝船残骸离去。
content_en:
The second treasure ship.
A familiar figure hangs at the bow of the ship, the leader of the Viper Gang—Cui Miaoren!
His injuries were severe.
The body was penetrated by a pair of dragon horns from the dragon's head, and the bones were pierced through the lute. The demon-like arms protruded from the shoulders, half of the head was cut off by some kind of brute force, and several seagull corpses were hung in the intestines.
"Demon... ghost..." Cui Miaoren lowered his head and muttered one sentence repeatedly as he was dying.
No one dared to touch him.
It is a miracle that he can survive such an injury.
If he were put down, he would die suddenly and instantly.
Qian Sanjin, the old leader of the Golden Knife Gang, stepped forward to check carefully.
"The bones all over his body were like mud, and his blood seemed to be poisoned. Even the seagulls that were eating it were poisoned to death. The injury on his head was caused by the aftermath of a punch."
Finally come to a conclusion.
"He is a master of the extreme innate realm!"
"In extreme panic, he activated the potential of the root bone more than once, from forging the bone... to opening the meridians." Xie Tianyu, the leader of the Viper Gang, sighed.
Everyone felt a chill in their hearts when they heard this.
How did Cui Miaoren survive like this? Is this luck or misfortune?
Just then.
Another exclamation: "There are still ships, the third ship is back!"
Everyone turned their heads.
Zhou Rongguang's expression changed drastically and he looked at Chen Guzhou who was calm and composed.
The muscles on his face couldn't help but twist.
A few moments.
The third treasure ship was pulled into the dock.
It was still the seventy-foot treasure ship built by Chen Guzhou. The ship's roof was stepped into the deck by a huge force, and the cabin was filled with the bloody mist residue of human tissue exploded.
Let alone a living person, there is not even a complete bone.
But the lower part of the treasure ship survived the brutal battle because of its hard frame.
And therefore.
Everyone found a key clue at the bottom of the cabin.
It was a liquid-like metal powder that remained in the gaps between the boards. A big hole opened in the bottom of the boat, as if some mysterious entity had penetrated the bottom of the boat and transported the cargo away.
Everyone looked at Xie Tianyu, the leader of the Viper Gang, and Qian Sanjin, the leader of the Golden Knife Gang.
Their faces were green and black, and they said nothing.
A long while.
Qian Sanjin said: "Please keep today's matter a secret. Later... I can come to my Golden Sword Gang to discuss it in detail with you."
Say it.
He led his people and left in a hurry.
Xie Tianyu, the leader of the Viper Gang, began to clean up the mess and expressed his gratitude to Chen Guzhou.
"Thanks to Master Chen's foresight this time, otherwise my brothers and sisters... I'm afraid they don't know how to die!" He gritted his teeth and said, "The Viper Gang will give you my thanks later, so I'll take my leave now."
"Thank you, Leader, for being so polite."
Chen Guzhou nodded slightly.
They watched the people from the Viper and Golden Knife Gang leave with the wreckage of the three treasure ships.
